messages:
alex-customer: Hey, after last night's model swap to pegasus-v2 we're seeing a big p99 jump on non-streaming /generate calls for long inputs (>8k tokens). p95 went from ~220ms -> ~1.1s and p99 to ~3.8s. request_id=9f7a2c. Anyone else noticing this?
sarah-support: Thanks for the report. Can you paste a minimal request payload and confirm streaming vs non-streaming?
alex-customer: Non-streaming. minimal cURL we used: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer X' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"pegasus-v2","input":"<very long document here ~12k chars>","max_tokens":512}'
```
We also included trace_id=trace-9f7.
mike-ops: @sarah-support seeing a cluster-wide spike starting ~03:20 UTC coincident with pegasus-v2 rollout. p95 baseline -> 1.1s, p99 ~3.8s for long-context routable hosts. Logs show token_count explosion in tokenizer step for several requests, increasing sequence length ~4x. traces: https://traces.redwood/trace/9f7a2c
harry-ml: That smells like a change in the BPE/merge table or normalization differences. If tokenization produces many more tokens (especially with CJK and punctuation), KV cache lookups and attention cost go up nonlinearly. @jenna-eng can you reproduce locally with the customer's sample?
jenna-eng: grabbing sample now. Quick repro: run pegasus-v2 tokenizer on their payload -> token_count 11,200 (expected ~2,700 with pegasus-v1). Repro steps: `python -c "from redwood_tokenizer import PegasusTokenizer; t=PegasusTokenizer('pegasus-v2'); print(len(t.encode(open('sample.txt').read())))"`
jenna-eng: Immediate mitigation options: revert tokenizer merge-table change (PR #1428), enable aggressive normalization fallback flag (--norm-fallback) or route affected orgs to pegasus-v1.
evelyn-cs: Customer asked for an interim mitigation ASAP. Can we route their org (org-458) back to pegasus-v1 until this is fixed? They rely on low latency.
mike-ops: Routing policy applied: org:org-458 -> pegasus-v1 (override) at 03:45 UTC, TTL 1h. Added throttles for >6k token requests to avoid downstream tail. Monitoring p99 now. :eyes:
alex-customer: Confirmed — after routing to pegasus-v1 we're back to previous numbers. p99 dropped to ~650ms on sampled calls. Thanks. :thumbsup:
jenna-eng: Opening hotfix branch with tokenizer revert and a unit test reproducer. PR created: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/1429 (hotfix/tokenizer-pegasus-revert). I'll prepare a rollback PR if ops wants full revert.
harry-ml: Long-term actions: (1) add tokenization preflight to model onboarding checks (compare token_count distributions on representative corpora), (2) add seq-length guard in serving runtime that emits early slower-path or reject with 413-like hint, (3) update onboarding runbook.
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-037-pegasus-token-surge. Priority: P2. Assigned groups: eng-runtime, eng-ml.
oncall-bot: @jenna-eng you're oncall for eng-runtime. Please ack and estimate time to rollback or patch.
jenna-eng: ack. I'll aim to get a hotfix out within 45m and coordinate canary rollback if needed.
alex-customer: Appreciate the quick handling. Please keep us posted and tell us when the permanent fix lands.
sarah-support: Noted — we'll keep the routing in place until the patch is verified. I'll follow up with the customer and provide the incident link.
mike-ops: Monitoring dashboards show no p99 flare for org-458 after the route change. Rolling baseline checks across other orgs now.
jenna-eng: Hotfix PR in review, CI green for tokenizer revert tests. Preparing canary rollout to a small slice, will report results in 15m.
evelyn-cs: Customer reply: "Thanks — latency baseline restored and our production traffic looks normal. We'll keep you updated if anything else shows up"
jenna-eng: Canary looks good (no token_count blowups). Merging hotfix and scheduling a controlled rollback of pegasus-v2 tokenizer changes. Will follow-up with postmortem and onboarding checklist updates.
harry-ml: filing a short blameless postmortem and adding automated tokenization regressions to the model onboarding pipeline.
alex-customer: Thank you everyone, great response time.
sarah-support: Closing thread once postmortem links are added. :white_check_mark:
